summary: Crook County, OR crow's nest lookout in the Ochoco National Forest; the register dates it to 1940 yet a 1936 photo shows a lookout, and it is now gone.

facts.design: Crow's nest lookout per the register; a 1931 newspaper item described a planned twenty-foot wood tower
facts.status_note: Now gone per the register; Firelookout.com lists it as abandoned. No source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Register date for the crow's nest lookout; a 1936 panorama conflicts (see resolved_conflicts)
Panoramic photograph of the View Point Lookout dated August 23, 1936

evidence.supports: in the Ochoco National Forest, Crook County, Oregon
April 1931 newspaper item about a planned tower at View Point
evidence.quote: A twenty foot wood tower to be constructed at View Point.

evidence.supports: register gives 1940 for the crow's nest lookout
evidence.quote: Built in 1940, this crow's nest lookout is now gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1940, but its own 1936 panorama of the View Point Lookout and Firelookout.com's 1930s date point to an earlier lookout. The 1931 newspaper item describes a plan, so it does not settle the date.

notes_for_editor: Build date is disputed: 1940 (register), 1930s (Firelookout.com), a 1936 panorama captioned View Point Lookout, and a 1931 plan for a 20-foot wood tower. The story says so and does not pick one. The brief's kind 'platform' fits the register's crow's nest wording, so it is unchanged. No source gives the site's condition or access today. Used 2 WebSearch and 3 page reads.
